# Lob

Direct Mail Automation and Address Verification APIs

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/lob/.

## Actions

- **Create Domain**: Add a new custom domain for creating custom links.
- **Create Link**: Create a shortened URL from a long URL using Lob's link shortening service.
- **Delete Domain**: Delete a registered domain.
- **Get Domain** (read-only): Retrieve details for a single domain from Lob.
- **Get Link** (read-only): Retrieve a single shortened link.
- **List Domains** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all created domains.
- **List Shortened Links** (read-only): Retrieve a list of shortened links.
- **Validate Identity** (read-only): Validate whether a given name is associated with an address.
- **Delete Link**: Delete a shortened link.
- **Delete Upload**: Delete an existing upload by its unique identifier.
- **List QR Code Analytics** (read-only): Retrieve a list of your QR codes and their analytics data.
- **List Uploads** (read-only): List uploads from Lob.
- **Update Link**: Update any properties of a shortened link.
